fields.System.Title: OUT-501 — Scan items into a carton
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer, I want to scan each item as it goes into the box, so that the record of
what shipped is built from what I actually packed.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a picked cart or tote, when I scan it, then I see what the order should
  • contain.
  • - Given a scanned product that belongs to the order, then it is added to the open
  • carton.
  • - Given a scanned product that is not on the order, then it is rejected and flagged for
  • investigation.
  • - Given more units scanned than the order requires, then the extra is rejected.
  • - Given the carton, then its contents are recorded per product and per batch or serial
  • where tracked.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | carton, carton_content |
| Risks | Packing items that were never picked ([doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
